openings.claim: Timestamp-independent localization should require verified artifact correspondence, rather than treating manifest position as sufficient to order comparable boundaries.
openings.delta: Replace the prior ordering dependency with a correspondence gate. In the supplied spreadsheet or script ledger, inspect each available record once, reuse its fields across both variants, and mark boundary correspondence as supported or unresolved using the dictionary and identifiers. Manifest order remains expected order; equality anchors never prove unrecorded execution.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: G0446 timestamp-independent manifest-order comparison without this explicit gate. The gated variant should withhold definite localization when apparent adjacency lacks supported correspondence, potentially widening intervals. Differing observations are cited stage claims, interval endpoints, answer-sheet agreement and total manual inspections. No improvement is established.
openings.probe: Apply both ledger variants within each of the two supplied three-pair subsets, reusing one inspected field table and counting manual inspections jointly, capped at twelve per pair. Freeze all six reports, references and next checks before opening either answer sheet. Apply final-review record removals before freezing. Use retained records for next checks. This paired comparison reduces the prior disjoint-allocation ambiguity; report order effects and answer-sheet coverage limits.
assumptions: Indispensable uncertainty: the dictionary and identifiers may not establish corresponding artifact boundaries. If insufficient, report the unresolved interval and a bounded recheck of retained records.
Defeat: the gate rejects supported boundaries without reducing unsupported claims, or answers cannot distinguish variants.

Capacity: one pass over at most twelve records per pair supplies both tables; duplicate inspections consume that same allowance. Whether six tables and comparison fit sixty plus twenty minutes is unverified; record incompletion explicitly. The cap alone proves no feasibility.
Separate mismatches from explanations; every definite stage claim cites a supplied record. This is a probe, not deployment.

assessment: One opening tests the prior correspondence prerequisite while preserving missing-record uncertainty. Feasibility and informative answer coverage remain unknown.
